value.value: @concat('There were errors encountered when loading ',variables('FileName'),' from <',variables('ImportPath',variables('QuarantinePath'),'> as ',variables('QuarantineFileName'),' and the members will not be loaded to the dialer for the next creation of the call list.')

@replace(variables('FileName'),'.xls',concat('_',formatDateTime(formatDateTime(utcnow(),'M/d/yyyy hh:mm:ss tt'), 'yyyy'),(if(formatDateTime(formatDateTime(utcnow(),'M/d/yyyy hh:mm:ss tt'), 'MM') < 10, '0', '')),formatDateTime(formatDateTime(utcnow(),'M/d/yyyy hh:mm:ss tt'), 'MM'),(if(dayOfMonth(formatDateTime(utcnow(),'M/d/yyyy hh:mm:ss tt')) < 10, '0', '')),dayOfMonth(formatDateTime(utcnow(),'M/d/yyyy hh:mm:ss tt')),'.xls'))

@concat('NoMemberMatch_NEWMBRMANUAL137_',formatDateTime(formatDateTime(utcnow(),'M/d/yyyy hh:mm:ss tt'), 'yyyy'),notConvertedectfunctionstringright(concat('0',formatDateTime(formatDateTime(utcnow(),'M/d/yyyy hh:mm:ss tt'), 'MM')), 2),notConvertedectfunctionstringright(concat('0',dayOfMonth(formatDateTime(utcnow(),'M/d/yyyy hh:mm:ss tt'))), 2),'.txt')

scripts.text: SELECT COUNT(S.MEMBERLIST_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER) FROM PDS_MEMBERLIST_STAGING S LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_MEMBER M ON S.MEMBERLIST_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER = M.MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_CALLLIST_137_HISTORY H ON H.CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_SBSB_ID + '00' = S.MEMBERLIST_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER AND H.CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_CASE_ID = S.MEMBERLIST_STAGING_EXTRADATA WHERE S.MEMBERLIST_STAGING_FILEIMPORT_IID = @item.name AND (M.MEMBER_IID IS NULL OR H.CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_CASE_IID IS NULL)
